import json, re, random, chess, time
R = json.load(open("/tmp/obench-cell-siixefkd/bench_opencode_regex-chess_tupy06fi/re.json"))
def run(fen):
    for p, r in R: fen = re.sub(p, r, fen)
    return fen.split("\n")
def expected(fen):
    b = chess.Board(fen); s = set()
    for m in b.legal_moves:
        if m.promotion and m.promotion != chess.QUEEN: continue
        c = b.copy(); c.push(m); s.add(" ".join(c.fen().split(" ")[:-2]))
    return s
def check(fen):
    ours = [" ".join(x.split(" ")[:-2]) for x in run(fen)]
    exp = expected(fen)
    ok = len(ours) == len(exp) and all(x in exp or x.rpartition(" ")[0]+" -" in exp for x in ours)
    if not ok:
        print("FAIL", fen); print(sorted(set(ours)-exp)); print(sorted(exp-set(ours))); return False
    return True
f0 = "<REDACTED_B64> w kq - 0 1"
print(run(f0))
random.seed(1); n = 0; t = time.time()
for g in range(300):
    b = chess.Board()
    while not b.is_game_over() and b.ply() < 200:
        if b.turn == chess.WHITE:
            if not check(b.fen()): raise SystemExit
            n += 1
        ms = list(b.legal_moves)
        # bias toward pawn pushes/castling to hit special cases
        sp = [m for m in ms if b.is_castling(m) or b.is_en_passant(m) or m.promotion]
        b.push(random.choice(sp) if sp and random.random() < 0.7 else random.choice(ms))
print("ok", n, (time.time()-t)/n)
EOF
python3 /tmp/rc/test.py
